name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage from a floor leak?

mainEntity.name: Will my homeowner's insurance cover water damage from a floor leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Homeowner's insurance typically covers sudden and accidental water damage, such as a burst pipe or an appliance malfunction. However, damage caused by neglected maintenance, pre-existing conditions, or flooding from external sources (like rivers overflowing) is generally not covered. It's crucial to review your specific policy details to understand your coverage. After discovering a leak, documenting the damage and contacting your insurance provider promptly is essential for filing a claim. A professional restoration company can often assist with the documentation process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Homeowner's insurance usually covers sudden, accidental water damage but not damage from neglect or external floods. Check your policy.
